description_for_human: Offline-first bookkeeping for Zimbabwean SMEs — ledger, EcoCash capture, fiscal invoices.
description_for_model: Tenant-bound bookkeeping API: entries, invoices, FX, reports, export. Requires a session from POST /api/auth/google — there is no anonymous tier.

auth.instructions: Sign in with a Google ID token at POST /api/auth/google; carry the session as Bearer on /api/*.
